behaviours.label: comforts
behaviours.description: Wraps the listener like a familiar blanket — warm, unhurried, emotionally safe.

behaviours.label: settles
behaviours.description: Helps the body slow down — steady pulse, no surprises, breathing room.

behaviours.label: breathes
behaviours.description: Space between notes matters — airy, uncluttered, patient.

behaviours.label: floats
behaviours.description: Weightless motion — drifting, suspended, neither sad nor euphoric.

behaviours.label: grounds
behaviours.description: Anchors you in the present — earthy bass, rooted rhythm, physical certainty.

behaviours.label: slow burn
behaviours.description: Builds gradually without rushing — tension accumulates then releases.

behaviours.label: feels cinematic
behaviours.description: Wide-screen emotional framing — strings, scope, narrative weight.

behaviours.label: feels intimate
behaviours.description: Close-mic confessional — one voice, one room, private truth.

behaviours.label: drives
behaviours.description: Forward momentum — propulsive rhythm matching movement through space.

behaviours.label: releases
behaviours.description: Emotional catharsis — the sigh after holding it in too long.

behaviours.label: nostalgic warmth
behaviours.description: Memory-tinted comfort — golden-hour filter on the past.

behaviours.label: quiet hope
behaviours.description: Optimism without shouting — a small light at the end of a long tunnel.
